mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dogs ( id, owner_id, name, breed, stage, bond, status, explore_location, explore_ends_at, explore_duration_hours, explore_skill_id, explore_skill_snapshot_id, explore_skill_snapshot_level, explore_skill_snapshot_version, race_count, race_first_count, weekly_points, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{ownerId}, #{name}, #{breed}, #{stage}, #{bond}, #{status}, #{exploreLocation}, #{exploreEndsAt}, #{exploreDurationHours}, #{exploreSkillId}, #{exploreSkillSnapshotId}, #{exploreSkillSnapshotLevel}, #{exploreSkillSnapshotVersion}, #{raceCount}, #{raceFirstCount}, #{weeklyPoints}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dogs WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE dogs SET status = 'exploring', explore_location = #{location}, explore_ends_at = #{exploreEndsAt}, explore_duration_hours = #{durationHours}, explore_skill_snapshot_id = #{snapshotSkillId}, explore_skill_snapshot_level = #{snapshotSkillLevel}, explore_skill_snapshot_version = #{snapshotSkillVersion}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'idle'
